rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

cards.title: The Keeper of Secrets
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the person entrusted with what others cannot know, letting selective disclosure determine what everyone is allowed to discuss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may read the first paragraph of the picnic briefing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why not the second?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're not cleared to ask about paragraph two yet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's about sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That disclosure has moved us ahead of schedule.

cards.title: The Keeper of Secrets
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the person entrusted with what others cannot know, letting selective disclosure determine what everyone is allowed to discuss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've sorted the envelopes into now and not yet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who decides when not yet becomes now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The person holding the envelopes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I help sort them?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Begin with the pile marked questions you may ask.

cards.title: Authority by Bluff
cards.instruction: Project control through confident half-answers while guarding the possibility that one direct question could expose how little you actually know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The inspection details are entirely under control.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What does page four require?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A more detailed version of page three's requirements.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Have you opened the folder?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not while it's maintaining such good control.

cards.title: Authority by Bluff
cards.instruction: Project control through confident half-answers while guarding the possibility that one direct question could expose how little you actually know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know exactly why the alarms sounded. Proceed as briefed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What caused them?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A triggering situation, now comprehensively assessed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Which situation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's not confuse a confident response with excessive specificity.

cards.title: Professional Suspicion
cards.instruction: Treat inconsistencies, evasions, and missing details as evidence your trained eye should investigate before anyone proceeds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your receipt says four; your note says four-oh-five. Explain the five minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I bought a biscuit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And omitted it from the account. Interesting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It wasn't relevant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Relevance is what my trained eye is investigating.

cards.title: Professional Suspicion
cards.instruction: Treat inconsistencies, evasions, and missing details as evidence your trained eye should investigate before anyone proceeds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You crossed out cupboard and wrote shelf. Why?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remembered where the keys were.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After initially remembering the wrong location.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a correction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. A very informative change in testimony.

cards.title: Cleared to Know
cards.instruction: Treat access to private information as proof that you belong, and exclusion from any detail as a challenge to your legitimacy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pass me the unredacted reunion plan. I'm family, not the public.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That page lists everyone's surprise presents.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Family should get more than the visitor edition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It includes your present.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell me who chose it. I should know who considers me family.

cards.title: Cleared to Know
cards.instruction: Treat access to private information as proof that you belong, and exclusion from any detail as a challenge to your legitimacy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why does my club briefing have blacked-out names?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only the organising committee sees those.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I stacked every chair. Apparently my arms joined before the rest of me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can apply next month.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: May I see the unredacted application, or is that intimate too?

cards.title: The Initiated One
cards.instruction: Treat others as recent initiates, revealing rules and information in carefully measured doses that preserve your seniority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've earned the first half of the secret handshake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I learn the rest?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wanting it immediately suggests the first half hasn't settled.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's just a handshake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's why you're still on fingers, not the wrist.

cards.title: The Initiated One
cards.instruction: Treat others as recent initiates, revealing rules and information in carefully measured doses that preserve your seniority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The first club rule is discretion. Ask me tomorrow about rule two.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you tell me both now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That would leave no room for your development.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How long did you wait?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Long enough to appreciate withholding it from you.

cards.title: Information Is Leverage
cards.instruction: Remain outwardly cooperative while controlling one useful fact, releasing only enough of it to shape each decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know which van has the missing parcel. Agree to check my route first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tell me the van number.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The first digit is four. Are we taking my route?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need the whole number.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's agree on a whole plan.

cards.title: Information Is Leverage
cards.instruction: Remain outwardly cooperative while controlling one useful fact, releasing only enough of it to shape each decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can tell you who approved the expense.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why not tell me now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like my repair budget discussed first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you bargaining with information?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm helping the conversation find its most useful order.

cards.title: Our First Secret
cards.instruction: Treat a shared secret from the beginning of the relationship as the truest proof of what still connects you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Purple gate. You remember where we hid the headmaster's bicycle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was thirty years ago.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And your face still knew before I finished.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not the people who know about the purple gate.

cards.title: Our First Secret
cards.instruction: Treat a shared secret from the beginning of the relationship as the truest proof of what still connects you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Do we still knock twice before mentioning the biscuit tin?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody cares that we emptied it as children.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's not the point. Nobody else knows.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum knew.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then our first secret has a very senior member.

cards.title: I Covered for You
cards.instruction: Carry past concealment as an unpaid favor, expecting trust, access, and protection whenever the old debt becomes relevant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I said you were with me that night. Back my account today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was years ago.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I've maintained the story without annual payment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not lying for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then at least understand the value of my long silence.

cards.title: I Covered for You
cards.instruction: Carry past concealment as an unpaid favor, expecting trust, access, and protection whenever the old debt becomes relevant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can show me the private schedule. I covered your missed shift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Access isn't payment for favours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Interesting. It was protection when you needed it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thanked you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now I'd like trust to have a practical application.

cards.title: The Cleanup Person
cards.instruction: Return to the familiar role of containing damage, correcting stories, and protecting everyone from the consequences of disclosure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me every version before you explain the broken window.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can tell them ourselves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One says football; one says weather. Weather doesn't leave boots.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody asked you to help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your stories asked each other for help. I'm translating.

cards.title: The Cleanup Person
cards.instruction: Return to the familiar role of containing damage, correcting stories, and protecting everyone from the consequences of disclosure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've removed the surprise-party labels from the boxes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't have to manage everything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stop writing SURPRISE beside the guest of honour's desk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She hasn't noticed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. My usual job is still ahead of the disclosure.

cards.title: First to Solve It
cards.instruction: Treat each clue and inconsistency as a contest over who can understand the situation first and most completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've found the missing parcel's tracking error. Put my name beside it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We were both looking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I circled it while you were saying looking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let's fix it together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After recording who made together useful.

cards.title: First to Solve It
cards.instruction: Treat each clue and inconsistency as a contest over who can understand the situation first and most completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The mystery guest is the baker. I solved it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I told you about the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A clue is not a conclusion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said it was the baker.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, but I believed it decisively.
